gloss: to write down; to note; to jot down

definitions.gloss: to write down; to note; to jot down
definitions.explanation: To record something in writing so as not to forget it.

examples.japanese: {電話番号|でんわばんごう}を{書|か}き{留|と}めた。
examples.english: I wrote down the phone number.

examples.japanese: {大事|だいじ}なことはメモに{書|か}き{留|と}めておこう。
examples.english: Let's jot down the important things in a memo.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{内容|ないよう}を{詳|くわ}しく{書|か}き{留|と}める。
examples.english: I'll note down the meeting contents in detail.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{書|か}き{留|と}める → {書|か}き{留|と}めない (negative)
・{書|か}き{留|と}める → {書|か}き{留|と}めて (te-form)
・{書|か}き{留|と}める → {書|か}き{留|と}めた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {書|か}く (to write) + {留|と}める (to stop, to fasten)
The sense of {留|と}める contributes the meaning of "securing" the information.

USAGE:
・〜を{書|か}き{留|と}める (to write down ~)
・{書|か}き{留|と}めておく (to write down and keep for later)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・メモする - to take notes (colloquial)
・{記録|きろく}する - to record (formal)
・{控|ひか}える - to note down, to refrain
